riskCategories.words: Someone can read or change what they should not
Input from outside is used without checks, so it can change what the code does
Passwords, keys or tokens are kept where others can read them
Data is protected by weak or fixed encryption
Personal or confidential data is exposed or kept longer than needed
A technology is out of support or no longer receives fixes
Data can end up wrong, lost or inconsistent
Failures are hidden, lost or not retried
Releasing or running the system depends on manual or missing steps
One thing is defined in several places that can drift apart
Behaviour depends on code we do not have the source for
Error details, internal addresses or tokens are shown to people or callers who should not see them
Behaviour lives where a rebuild could miss it: in screens, browser code or the database
